jobs.description:
Dive into a dynamic role where your skills in mechanical assembly will keep everything in its rightful place. As a Pre-Assembly Worker, you’ll be responsible for the meticulous assembly and disassembly of tooling on our state-of-the-art roll forming lines. Your day will involve transporting and maintaining tooling, ensuring a clean and safe workspace, and reporting any repairs or improvements needed. If you thrive in a detail-oriented environment and are eager to learn, this is the perfect opportunity for you.

A typical day sees you inspecting your own work for precision, collaborating with team members, and operating both conventional and CNC-controlled machines. You’ll ensure that every piece meets our high standards of quality and accuracy. This role requires independent work, flexibility, and a keen eye for detail, making sure every component fits perfectly.

Ready to take the next step in your career? Apply now and join a team where your contributions will make a real impact. Click the apply button and start your journey with us today!

• Education in mechanics or equivalent experience

• Proficiency in reading and executing mechanical diagrams

• Fluency in English

• Eagerness to learn, conscientiousness, and sense of responsibility

• Ability to work independently and safely

• Flexibility and willingness to work in a 2-shift system

• Detail-oriented with a strong focus on quality, order, and cleanliness

• Technical background or equivalent experience

Are you ready to take the next step in your career as a Technical Operator? As a vital member of our team, you'll work with cutting-edge machinery to produce high-quality steel profiles. You'll become an expert in operating our state-of-the-art equipment, ensuring that production runs smoothly and efficiently.

Every day, you'll engage with complex and simple finishing machines including conventional and CNC-controlled systems like sawing machines, drilling machines, and laser cutters. Your keen attention to detail and commitment to quality will ensure that every component meets our high standards.

We're looking for motivated and eager-to-learn individuals. Apply now to join a supportive environment where your skills will be valued and developed!

• Technical school diploma or equivalent experience

• Proficiency in reading and executing mechanical diagrams

• Fluency in English

• Knowledge of pneumatics and ability to install tubes and test movements

• Passion for technology and a team-oriented mindset

• Eagerness to learn with a conscientious and responsible approach

• Strict adherence to safety rules and flexibility in working hours

Are you an experienced orderpicker looking for a new challenge in logistics? Do you enjoy working in a warehouse where accuracy and efficiency are important? Then this might be the perfect job for you!

For our client, we are looking for a motivated orderpicker to support daily inbound and outbound warehouse operations.

Your main responsibilities:

• Picking and preparing orders using an RF scanner.

• Receiving, checking and storing incoming goods (inbound).

• Preparing, packing and dispatching outgoing orders (outbound).

• Keeping the warehouse clean, organized and safe.

We are looking for an experienced warehouse worker who is reliable, accurate and ready to get things done.

• You have previous experience in orderpicking or warehouse operations.

• You have experience working with RF scanners.

• You speak English, which is required for safety and communication.

• Knowledge of Dutch or Spanish is a plus.

• Experience operating a forklift or reachtruck is an advantage.

• You are flexible and willing to work in three rotating shifts. (Early shift: 07:40 – 16:15, Day shift: 08:40 – 17:15, Late shift: 12:40 – 21:15)

Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is a subsidiary of Safran Aircraft Engines, based at Brussels Airport (Zaventem & Steenokkerzeel, Belgium), specialized in the inspection, maintenance and repair (MRO) of the advanced LEAP jet engines that power the latest generation of the Airbus A320NEO & Boeing B737MAX narrow body families. The company is a key player in the integrated CFM international MRO network. With more than 75 years of experience, and up to 20 international Part 145 certifications (EASA/ FAA/ CAAC/ …), Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is recognized as a worldwide center of expertise in the air transport industry. More than a 100 airlines, lessors, private aircraft operators and MRO partners have entrusted their engines to our company. We employ over 600 highly skilled, passionate and enthusiastic employees.Join our Technical Department team as a Production Support Technician! In this role, you will be responsible for developing work instructions and methods, as well as providing the necessary production tools to ensure smooth workflow in the workshops and high-quality outcomes for our customers.

Your role:

• You analyze the technical information obtained from the manufacturer via the Engineering department and integrate it into the ERP system.
• You are responsible for writing, updating and translating the technical working documents, taking into account the strict application of the aviation regulations and the instructions of the manufacturer. You ensure the implementation of the technical working documents in the workshops and ensure their correct application.
• You participate in the continuous improvement processes within the department.
• You participate and/or coordinate the improvements of the current working methods and introduce possible new technologies. You ensure the sharing of information as a result of 'retour d'expérience' (RETEX) by means of an infoshop for the mechanics in case of new or improved work instructions.
• You provide technical support to the workshops, both theoretical and practical (if necessary), and look for solutions in case of problems in order to avoid a delay of the production process. You ensure the delivery of the necessary tooling to the workshops and guarantee its correct use by drawing up adequate work instructions.
• You participate in the industrialisation (MRO and NEW) of new types of engines.
• You make repair proposals to the manufacturer in order to make the parts repairable.
• You draw up specifications for the means of production.

Your profile:

• Bachelor's degree in electromechanics or aeronautics, preferably with a first experience in repair methods.
• You speak French or Dutch, with a good knowledge of the other national language and you are willing to improve your skills. You also have a good knowledge of technical English.
• You have good knowledge of electromechanics, mechanics and repair technologies.
• You have knowledge of engines and engine parts.
• You are an analytical and synthetic person and can anticipate.
• You enjoy working in a team, in a multilingual environment and you are willing to support your colleagues.
Candidates must be legally authorized to work in Belgium, holding either an EU passport or a valid work & residence permit. Please note that we do not provide assistance with visa or permit applications.
